review.summary: Standard views plus full-resolution underside comparison inspected. The 14155-triangle fixture retains the square diffuser/bezel, rear enclosure and mounting tabs. The actual visible underside stays close to the approved source, with no missing diffuser or frame. Fresh FBX/GLB checks pass. Published preview shows the underside; original studio and all upper views are retained.

issues.problem: Small edge/shading nicks are visible from above after reduction; the broad underside remains smooth.
Source-stage dark corner seams and uneven fine rim detail remain.

review.summary: Dedicated underside inspection confirms a pale warm diffuser within a white square bezel. Rear views retain a separate cool metallic enclosure and mounting hardware. No unwanted labels or broad material smears are present.

issues.problem: Small dark corner seams and uneven rim detail are stronger than in the clean reference.
